name: update_patient

messages.content: Thanks for your patience, I'm still working on that.

description: Update fields on an existing patient record: a returning caller (after find_patient_by_phone or verify_caller), or a correction to a record already saved earlier in this same call. For a record saved in this call, date_of_birth may be omitted; otherwise the caller must restate their date of birth to verify identity before any change is applied. Never use create_patient for a correction.

patient_id.description: The patient_id from SAVED/ALREADY_SAVED earlier in this call, or from MATCH/VERIFIED.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as MM/DD/YYYY, restated by the caller to verify identity. For a record saved earlier in this call, pass the date of birth that was saved (or omit it).

fields.description: Only the fields being changed, e.g. {"phone_number": "2125550123"}.
